subtitle: A closer look at my background, how I work, and the results I deliver.
paragraphs: Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise data pipelines, cloud-based ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouses, and analytical data platforms. Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake, Apache Spark, PySpark, Informatica PowerCenter/IICS, Oracle, Teradata, Airflow, and AutoSys.
